##### Sever the Possessing Shadow - Purification
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 10 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Choose one creature you can see that is possessed, spiritually contaminated, or serving as an anchor for an Unclean force.
Make a Cultivation Check against the possessing or corrupting effect’s Save DC. If the effect has no Save DC, use the responsible creature’s Save DC or a DC set by the GM.
Success: Suppress the possession or corruption until the end of your next turn. During that time, the host may immediately repeat one saving throw or contested check to end or weaken the effect with Advantage. If the effect is ordinary for its Realm, it ends instead.
